predictions.rationale: This is the main controller for handling order-related API endpoints, directly implementing the order creation, tracking, and cancellation processes.
Represents the core domain model for orders, encapsulating order state, status, and business logic for the ordering process.
Handles the creation of orders at checkout, a primary aspect of the ordering process.
Handles the cancellation of orders, directly supporting the order cancellation feature.
Implements queries for retrieving order information, supporting order tracking and status retrieval.
Defines the various statuses an order can have, crucial for tracking order progress through stock, payment, and shipment.
Handles the transition of an order to the stock confirmed status, a key step in the order lifecycle.
Handles updating the order status to paid, directly supporting payment tracking in the order process.
Handles the shipment of orders, supporting the shipment tracking aspect of the feature.
Defines the repository interface for accessing and manipulating order data, supporting all order operations.
